definitions.explanation: A passage or walkway inside a building that connects rooms or areas.

examples.japanese: {廊下|ろうか}を{走|はし}らないでください。
examples.english: Please don't run in the hallway.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{廊下|ろうか}は{長|なが}いです。
{廊下|ろうか}の{電気|でんき}を{点|つ}けてください。
examples.english: Please turn on the hallway light.

notes:
{廊下|ろうか} refers to indoor hallways or corridors.

{廊|ろう} = corridor, {下|か} = under (originally referring to covered walkways)

Usage contexts:
- {学校|がっこう}の{廊下|ろうか} (school hallway)
- {病院|びょういん}の{廊下|ろうか} (hospital corridor)
- {家|いえ}の{廊下|ろうか} (home hallway)
- ホテルの{廊下|ろうか} (hotel corridor)

Related terms:
- {通路|つうろ} (passageway - more general)
- {渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか} (covered walkway between buildings)
- {縁側|えんがわ} (veranda/engawa)

Common rules:
- {廊下|ろうか}を{走|はし}らない (Don't run in the hallway) - common school rule
- {廊下|ろうか}に{物|もの}を{置|お}かない (Don't leave things in the hallway)
